lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
@nextcloud/files: 54,639 B in 16 modules on the photos-main page, of which its root dist/index.mjs is 32,462 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
photos-main: 28,203 B beyond the first copy, focus-trap 13,656 B, @floating-ui/dom 7,308 B, @floating-ui/core 5,760 B.
photos-dashboard: 1,376 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/paths 738 B, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B, generated by vite 197 B.
photos-public: 1,384 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/paths 738 B, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B, generated by vite 197 B.
moment, 301,592 B on the photos-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,668 B on the photos-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
24 B in 2 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
